title: RSNA Knee Student Folds
subtitle: ConvNeXt-T student fold ckpts + OOF (warm-start goodpjw)
description: 5-fold student ConvNeXt-T (pseudo-label, warm-start goodpjw, 256px) checkpoints + OOF predictions. Version 1: fold0-fold3 (train-a/b COMPLETE 12 Okt; fold4 follows train-c on 17 Oct). Files: fold{0..3}.pt (state_dict, 123 MB each), oof_fold{0..3}.csv (val-split logit predictions per finding). Final val AUC per fold: 0.9255-0.9279 (gold 0.9189-0.9223). Source kernels: alverlfarfaraway/rsna-knee-student-train-a|b.
